'''59th Flight''' was a [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] of [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture'' droid starfighters]] in the service of the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
